title: Visit to the Albaicín and Sacromonte with a 10/10 guide.
text:
Essential free tour to learn a little more about the history of Granada.
In addition, the tour with Paco was spectacular. He immersed us in culture and anecdotes throughout the visit.
100% recommended. We will repeat.
author: josemar_ae372

title: Pleasant Discovery of Granada
text: We had a wonderful, well planned tour with our guide, Delfina!   We thought she explained the history of this city and Spain over the past 1000 years very well.   She astutely touched on the past and current political and religious realities.  Of course, the area and views were quite beautiful.  Highly recommended!
author: alsferra

title: Unmissable!!
text:
Excellent tour with the guides Francisco and Rubén!! Very relaxed, no rush, well-informed, and fun. 
This tour is essential for anyone who wants to learn more about the city and its history, curiosities, and tourist attractions.
author: annacN5010XT

title: Neighborhoods you cannot miss visiting
text: A highly recommended guided tour to understand how the city expanded little by little and with beautiful views of the old town. Our guide Marta was very attentive and explained the tour to us with enthusiasm and a desire to interact with the group. Thanks for your warmth Marta!
author: iruns2026

title: Recommended!
text: We met our guide (Lorena) at place nueva - it’s a big area but she was obvious as she stood with a big umbrella for us to find her. She took us all to a good spot to sit and listen as she introduced herself and shared history of the place before we set off. It was a great tour with frequent stops for us to see/listen to information about the history and culture of the area we were walking in. There was no mic/audio so she made sure we were all with her to hear what she was saying. It was a fascinating insight - she was welcoming and very knowledgable. We would not have appreciated the history
author: 59genevievej

title: Highly recommended tour with independent guides

title: Great introduction to Granada
text: Lorena was a fantastic guide. Friendly with lots of good information and history of Granada . I would recommend this tour for first time visitors to Granda.
author: A931SDtomr

title: A Wonderful Final Day in Granada
text:
I did this walking tour on the last day of my Granada trip, and I’m really glad I did. I had already seen many of the places, but the tour added the stories and context that helped connect everything together.

Our guide, Marta, was energetic, cheerful, and patient, especially during the climb through the Albaicín. She showed us hidden corners and beautiful viewpoints, and shared interesting details about local life in the Albaicín and Sacromonte.

I especially enjoyed the flamenco explanation and the little clapping and footwork demo. We also had time to visit a cave house and some free time
author: anagha_mishra

title: Marta’s Magic
text: Marta was an excellent guide with the right mix of education & entertainment. We learnt all about the religious history of Granada & the human history of A&S. Highly recommend.
